company_name: Xinxiang Shengda Filtration Technique Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-performance filtration solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Xinxiang Shengda Filtration Technique Co., Ltd. provides advanced filtration solutions specifically designed for the semiconductor industry, focusing on ultrahigh-purity gas filtration. Their products, including GPF and GSL series filters, are engineered to remove particles down to 1.5nm, ensuring compliance with stringent semiconductor manufacturing standards.
capabilities: GPF series filters for ultrahigh-purity gas filtration
GSL series filters for particle removal ≥1.5 nm
Unique sintering manufacturing process with no particle residues
316L stainless steel housing for enhanced durability

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Henan Province, where it operates as a high-tech enterprise and a filtration engineering research center.
